description: Parameter display functions of the original G2 editor (Mac v1.62, ParamText namespace). See re/notes/param-display.md; C++ port in core/src/param_text.cpp.

dispatch.rule: The number of values a display depends on selects the table: 1 single, 2 dual, 3 triple. Arguments are passed in order (own value first, then dependencies). Ids missing from a table use its default.
dispatch.dependency_ref: paramN = value of parameter N of the same module (current variation); modeN = module mode/static value N (PANL "S0"/"s0", module-info byte with bit 7 set)

AmpGainNew.formula: g = k[v]/2^21: type 0 "x%.2f" of g; else "%.1f" of 20*log10(g) ("-oo" at 0)

CompressorRatio.formula: ratio*10 r = u+10 / 2u / 5u-75 (u = v or v-35, x10 above 34): "%d.%d:1" below 10:1, else " %2d:1"

DXOscFreq.formula: fixed 0: "x%.2f" of c*(1+fine/100) (c=coarse, 0 -> 0.5); else 10^(coarse&3) * 10^(fine/100) Hz with 3/2/1/0 decimals ("%.0f Hz" with a space for the last decade)

DrumMstFreq.formula: note n = (v>>1)+16, half a semitone lower when v is even: "%.1fHz" (or "%.0fHz" from 100) of 440*2^((n-69)/12)

DrumSlvMult.formula: ratio 2^((v>>2 + (v&3)/4)/12): "N:1" when it is the nearest integer ratio, else "x%.2f"/"x%.1f"

From0to200Percent.formula: like From0to100 on 0..200 (exact at multiples of 16, 127="200"), "%.1f" of v*200/128, then "%"

LFOFreq.formula: range 0 Sub: period 699.05/(rate+1) s; 1 Lo: 0.0159*2^(rate/12) Hz; 2 Hi: 0.2555*2^(rate/12) Hz; 3 BPM: "%d" (BPM curve); 4 ClkSync: ratio table [rate>>2]; Hz below 0.1 shown as "%.1fs" period; "%.2f"/"%.1f"/"%.0f" by decade

OscFreqDep.formula: tuneMode 0 Semi: "%+3d %+4.0f"; 1 Freq: OscFreq; 2 Factor: OscFactor; 3 Partial: OscPartials; else Sub: OscSubFreq

Out2Dest.formula: Out 1/2, Out 3/4, FX 1/2, FX 3/4, Bus 1/2, Bus 3/4
